agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting - No Video Available - only audio available in City Clerk's Department
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
April 23, 2013
05:00 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Pastor Alex Aguas of Oak Hills Church
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamations recognizing the recipients of the 2012 City of Vista Employees Awards: Martha Cleavenger - Mayor's Excellence in Service; Kathy Valdez - Manager of the Year; and Robert Borowski - Employee of the Year.
P2.
Proclamations recognizing 2012 Miss Pride Princess Ortiz, Junior Miss Pride Audrey Kogler, Little Miss Pride Grace Summerhill, and Miss Teen Pride of Vista Brianna Molina.
P3.
Certificates of Appreciation to the members of the Vista - A Clean Environment Adopt-a-Block Group for their 2012 service to the community.
P4.
Proclamation Declaring May to be "National Bike to Work Month" and May 17, 2013, "National Bike to Work Day" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending February 28, 2013 (CC)
C4.
Fiscal Year 2012 State Homeland Security Program Grant Award (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , accepting grant funds of $21,250 in FY 2012 State Homeland Security Program funding and amending the FY 2012/13 Operating Budget.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the FY 2012 State Homeland Security Program Grant Assurances.
C5.
Fiscal Year 2011/2012 Urban Area Security Initiative Program Grant (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , accepting grant funds of $125,211 in FY 2011 Urban Area Security Initiative funding, accepting grant funds of $268,530 in FY 2012 Urban Area Security Initiative funding, and amending the FY 2012/13 Operating Budget.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the FY 2012 Urban Area Security Initiative Program Grant Memorandum of Understanding/Grant Assurances.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the Second Amendment to the agreement with Lynx Technologies for San Diego Regional Public Safety GIS Services.
C6.
Amendment to the Vista Development Code - Standards for Public Works Construction (CC)
1.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 16.04 of the Vista Development Code by Adopting the 2012 Edition of the Standard Specifications for Public Works Construction, and the September 2012 Edition of the San Diego Regional Standard Drawings Including Indices and Appendices by Reference with Additions and Amendments"; and
2.
Set May 14, 2013, as the date of the Public Hearing for adoption of the Ordinance.
C7.
This item was removed from the agenda by staff prior to posting.
C8.
Proposition 84 Storm Water Grant Program - Paseo Santa Fe Green Street Project (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , authorizing the City of Vista to enter into an agreement with the State of California regarding Proposition 84 Storm Water Grant Program funding and designating a representative to sign the agreement, and any amendments thereto, for the Paseo Santa Fe Green Street Project; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY 2012/13.
C9.
Collection of Delinquent FY 2012/2013 Property Related Administrative Citations (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for the collection of delinquent property related administrative citation charges; and
2.
Set June 11, 2013, as the date of the Public Hearing to levy assessments on the 2013/14 property tax roll for collection of delinquent property related administrative citations.
C10.
Collection of Delinquent Mandatory Trash Charges (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for collection of delinquent solid waste charges; and
2.
Set June 11, 2013, as the date of the Public Hearing to levy assessments on the 2013/14 property tax roll for collection of delinquent 2012/13 mandatory trash charges.
C11.
Facility Lease Agreement with MAAC Project Headstart (CC)
C12.
2013-2014 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Annual Action Plan and Revised 2012-2013 Annual Action Plan (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the 2013-2014 Annual Action Plan, authorizing submittal of the Plan to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development and authorizing the City Manager to approve and execute all related documents.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the revised 2012-2013 CDBG Annual Action Plan. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Property Assessed Clean Energy (PACE) Programs (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving associate membership in the California Enterprise Development Authority and authorizing the execution of an associate membership agreement.
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- , authorizing the City to join the FIGTREE PACE Program; authorizing California Enterprise Development Authority to conduct contractual assessment proceedings and levy contractual assessments within the territory of the city; and authorizing related actions.
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving an amendment to a Certain Joint Powers Agreement and consenting to inclusion of properties within the city's jurisdiction for inclusion in the California HERO program.
D2.
Solid Waste Franchise Fee Increase and Repeal of Special Assessment Collection (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving the Fifth Amendment to the agreement between the City of Vista and EDCO Disposal Corporation for Refuse Collection Services.
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista Repealing Sections 13.16.410 and 13.16.420 of the Vista Municipal Code for Special Assessment Collection."
D3.
Fiscal Year 2012/13 Third Quarter Financial Report (CC/CDC/BSD/SA)
1.
Receive the report.
2.
Adopt the following, amending the Operating Program Budget for FY 2012/13:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2013-
b.
Community Development Resolution No. 2013-
c.
Buena Sanitation District Board Resolution No. 2013-
3.
Adopt the following, amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY 2012/13:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2013-
b.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2013-
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Sewer Service Rates for Fiscal Years 2013/2014 through 2017/2018 (CC/BSD)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed sewer service rates for FY 2013/14 through FY 2017/18.
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Establishing Rates for Sewer Service Charges for the Vista Sewer System."
3.
Introduce and adopt Buena Sanitation District Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Buena Sanitation District Establishing Rates for Sewer Service Charges for the Buena Sewer System."
PH2.
Development Fee Update (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to consider revisions to the City's traffic impact fees, fire plan check and inspection fees, storm water plan check fees, and policies associated with the collection of these fees.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving revisions to the Arterial Street Improvements and Traffic Signal Development Impact Fees and Fire Plan Check, Permitting and Inspection Fees, and establishing a Storm Water Plan Check Fee.
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Sections 14.02.040, 17.40.050, and 17.60.090 of the Development Code and City Council Policy No. 300-13 Related to the Collection of Certain Development Impact Fees."
PH3.
Disposition and Development/Affordable Housing Agreement with Community Housing Works (North Santa Fe Housing Associates, LP) and Real Property Exchange (CC/CDC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to consider the terms of a Disposition and Development/Affordable Housing Agreement with the North Santa Fe Housing Associates, L.P. and to consider a Real Property Exchange Agreement.
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Disposition and Development/ Affordable Housing Agreement by and among the Commission, the Chartered City of Vista, and North Santa Fe Housing Associates, L.P., a California Limited Partnership. (Recommendation continued on following page)
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Disposition and Development/Affordable Housing Agreement by and among the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista acting as the Housing Authority of the City of Vista, the Chartered City of Vista, and North Santa Fe Housing Associates, L.P., a California Limited Partnership.
4.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Real Property Exchange Agreement with the Community Development Commission of the City of Vista with respect to certain properties.
5.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Real Property Exchange Agreement with the City of Vista with respect to certain properties.
PH4.
General Plan Amendment for the 2013-2021 Housing Element (PC 19-070) (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the General Plan Amendment for the 2013-2021 Housing Element.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving a Negative Declaration for the 2013-2021 Housing Element.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , adopting the 2013-2021 Housing Element.
PH5.
Mixed-Use Zone Amendment (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to consider an amendment to Chapter 18.35 of the Development Code related to commercial uses.
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 18.35 of the Development Code Related to Commercial Uses."
PH6.
Application for Federal Transit Administration Section 5310 Grant Funds from the California Department of Transportation (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding whether there is a local nonprofit service provider that is readily available to provide services in lieu of the Out & About Vista Senior Transportation Program. (Recommendation continued on following page)
2.
In the absence of such a provider, direct the City Manager to sign the "Public Agency Certification of No Readily Available Service Providers" document and submit the document to the California Department of Transportation as part of the funding application.
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , authorizing the submission of an application an application for FTA Section 5310 grant funds from the California Department of Transportation, authorizing the City Manager to sign the application on behalf of the City.
PH2.
Development Fee Update (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to consider revisions to the City's traffic impact fees, fire plan check and inspection fees, storm water plan check fees, and policies associated with the collection of these fees.
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , approving revisions to the Arterial Street Improvements and Traffic Signal Development Impact Fees and Fire Plan Check, Permitting and Inspection Fees, and establishing a Storm Water Plan Check Fee.
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2013- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Sections 14.02.040, 17.40.050, and 17.60.090 of the Development Code and City Council Policy No. 300-13 Related to the Collection of Certain Development Impact Fees."
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
